realesrgan-x4plus.notes: Baseline Real-ESRGAN photo model. Same family FreeScaler ships.

4xNomos8kSC.notes: 2023 ESRGAN photo model by Philip Hofmann. Trained for JPEG compression and slight blur.

ultrasharp-4x.notes: Kim2091 UltraSharp. Strong texture recovery. Non-commercial.

4xNomos2_otf_esrgan.notes: 2024 ESRGAN photo model. Real-ESRGAN on-the-fly JPEG and blur degradation. Exported from the author's safetensors. ONNX exported locally with spandrel (opset 17, dynamic H/W). Graph: input[1,3,height,width]; output[1,3,height,width].

4xRealWebPhoto_v4_dat2.notes: 2024 DAT-2 model for JPEG and web-compressed photos. ONNX exported locally with spandrel (opset 17, dynamic H/W). Graph: input[1,3,height,width]; output[Addoutput_dim_0,3,height,width].

spanx4_ch48.notes: Official SPAN 4x pretrain, 48 channels. Light and faithful. Apache-2.0 from the SPAN release mirrored by OpenModelDB. ONNX exported locally with spandrel (opset 17, dynamic H/W). Graph: input[1,3,height,width]; output[1,3,height,width].

scunet_color_real_psnr.notes: SCUNet blind real-image denoiser (PSNR checkpoint). 1x pre-step. Code Apache-2.0; weights from the KAIR v1.0 release. ONNX exported locally with spandrel (opset 17, dynamic H/W). Graph: input[1,3,height,width]; output[1,3,height,width].

4xNomos2_hq_drct-l.notes: Large DRCT-L photo model. Kept only if export and a small tiled run fit in 13 GB. ONNX exported locally with spandrel (opset 17, dynamic H/W). Graph: input[1,3,height,width]; output[Addoutput_dim_0,3,height,width].
